name: Cockpit
author: ReidenXerx
description: One hub for what the machine is doing right now: which AI sessions are working, waiting for you or idle, file transfers with real progress, long-running jobs, dirty repos, pending updates. Extensible with your own providers.

barWidget.description: At-a-glance status hub: agents, transfers, jobs, git, updates

schema.label: Rows per section
schema.description: How many rows each section shows before it is collapsed behind a count. Click a heading to see the rest.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the hub re-runs its providers while it is open. Each provider also declares its own cadence, so an expensive one is not re-run just because this ticked.
